newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates rise to 7.50-8.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates rise to 7.50-8.00 percent.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates rose on Monday in a 7.50-8.00 percent range amid a tighter dinar market as banks again subscribed heavily in the last CD auction, dealers said.

Bankers attributed a tighter market since Saturday to more banks tying up their funds in the last 15 million dinar CD (certificate of deposit) auction. Excess liquidity sent rates tumbling to a low 3.00 percent average last week.
Rates hovered in a 7.00-7.50 percent on Sunday.
